thread:
Julian: Heads up — infra is scheduling an EU host maintenance for Sat 02:00-03:00 UTC, so we need to reshuffle the release slots. Can people confirm if they can move/cover their waves? :alarm_clock:
Maya: I can move our mobile-feature slot earlier by 30m, still prefer to avoid overlapping the maintenance window. :+1:
Kevin: Our model-serving deploy (canary + scale) is currently set for Sat 02:15 — I can shift that to 01:45. No DB migrations. :eyes:
Olivia: I can take smoke ownership for the model-serving rollout if Kevin wants to focus on the deploy. Happy to run latency + error-rate checks. :shipit:
deploy-bot: !reserve-window confirmed for 2026-03-21T02:00Z-03:00Z (channel: eng-releases) — leave a note if you need a hard exclusion.
Julian: Thanks — new plan: Kevin moves model deploy to 01:45 UTC, Maya moves mobile-feature to 01:15 UTC, Olivia is smoke owner for model. Sophia will be backup smoke for infra signals.
Sophia: Putting the smoke checklist here (quick):
```
- confirm canary at 10% for 15min
- check p50/p95 latency vs baseline (dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/s/delta)
- verify error-rate < 0.5% and tail-redis errors none
- run end-to-end signin/test user (test@redwood.test)
- if regressions -> rollback to previous model tag
```
Maya: Quick Q — do we need to pause traffic migration to dedicated for any of these?
Kevin: No pause needed. We'll use traffic-split, 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 10min holds. No infra-level migrations.
Olivia: I'll run these commands during the canary and paste outputs: 
```
# check rollout status
kubectl -n inference get rollout model-serving | grep -E "progressing|available"
# fetch canary logs
kubectl -n inference logs -l app=model-serving --since=10m
```
monitor-bot: Alerting rules will be set to tier-critical for the window. I will post any SLO spikes to this thread.
Julian: Rollback plan: if p95 latency increases > 200ms or error-rate > 0.5% for 3 consecutive minutes, Olivia or Sophia execute rollback: `redwoodctl release rollback model-serving --to-tag v1.4.3` and set traffic back to 100% previous.
Maya: acked. I'll be on watch for mobile-feature and can help if tests overlap.
Kevin: I'll cut the canary at 01:45 UTC and tag the deploy in the release doc. Will ping here when canary goes live.
Olivia: Copy — I'll start checks at +5m after canary, will post short status updates.
Julian: One more thing — because of the EU host maintenance, avoid any large batch jobs between 02:00-02:45 UTC. If anyone has scheduled jobs, pls move them.
Maya: moved our nightly bundler to 00:50 UTC.
Kevin: done for my jobs as well.
Olivia: smoke owner checklist: posting final quick template so backups can take over if needed:
```
Smoke Owner Template
- Start time: <timestamp>
- Canary %: 10 -> 50 -> 100
- Key checks: latency, error-rate, token throughput
- Quick commands: kubectl get pods, logs, redwoodctl metrics tail
- Rollback command: redwoodctl release rollback model-serving --to-tag v1.4.3
- Contact: @Julian @Sophia
```
Julian: Perfect. If no objections, we'll lock this schedule in 30m and update the release calendar. Everyone please react with :thumbsup: if you’re good.
Kevin: :thumbsup:
Maya: :thumbsup:
Olivia: :thumbsup:
Sophia: :thumbsup:
Julian: Locked. Thanks all — see you on Sat 01:30 UTC for preflight. :coffee:
